title: Signed coefficient comparison interface
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a morphism of schemes and use the canonical pro-etale inverse image [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image]. Let $R$ and $S$ be commutative ring sheaves on $Y$ and $X$, respectively, let $c:f^{-1}R\simeq S$, and let $L$ and $M$ be module sheaves over $R$ and $S$. Use the signed tensor and dual powers $L(d)$ and $M(d)$ [sk-def-sp-tate-twist]. The signed comparison structure consists of isomorphisms $f^*L(d)\simeq M(d)$ for every $d\in\mathbf Z$, with the coefficient-map equation in degree zero, the pure-tensor multiplication equation for positive powers, and the evaluation equation for negative powers, all on inverse-image generators through the pullback adjunction unit. It also carries, for every signed degree, a natural isomorphism between first twisting then applying derived pullback and first applying derived pullback then twisting. These are precisely the signed, zero, positive, negative and derived fields of SpSignedComparison.

structure SpSignedComparison
    (R : Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology Y) CommRingCat.{u + 1})
    (S : Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) CommRingCat.{u + 1})
    (c : (Scheme.proEtaleSheafInverseImage f CommRingCat.{u + 1}).obj R ≅ S)
    (L : Scheme.proEtaleRingModules Y R) (M : Scheme.proEtaleRingModules X S)
lean.note: The exact canonical signed comparison structure already exists in Sheaf.Paper.CartesianCoefficientTwists. It carries all signed-degree isomorphisms and zero, positive, negative, and derived normalization fields; no copy or choice of spFiniteTwists_cartesian is introduced.
